newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening steady but mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening steady but mixed.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open steady but mixed on Monday, as the market digested second quarter earnings reports.
"A lot of stock-watchers will look to see if the Dow can get through the magic 8,000 number, but on balance, it's going to be a market focused on earnings and economic data."
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index was unchanged at 924.40. The long bond lost 6/32 to yield 6.54 percent.
There were no economic data due out today, but industrial production and the consumer price index for June were set to be released on Wednesday.
